items.title: Kodi Integration cannot be reloaded if Kodi instance is currently playing something
items.excerpt:

items.title: Cast: playback on Nest Hubs stops when HA disconnects (temporary groups, HA restart) since 2026.11
items.excerpt:
### The problem

Since updating to 2026.11 (PyChromecast 14.0.10 → 14.1.1), Home Assistant's Cast integration stops playback on Google Nest devices that it is only observing (no automation or service call involved):

1. **Temporary speaker groups.** Start TuneIn radio on a Nest Hub by voice, then add a second Nest Hub from the first hub's screen ("Kitchen display + 1"). Both stop 35–80 s later: 4 out of 4 tries. HA connects to the temporary group as soon as it is announced (`DynamicCastGroup`). When the group's mDNS record blinks (removed and re-added within ~0.1 s), HA cleans up the group and sends `CLOSE` to the receiver and to the media session's transport. About 95 ms later both devices drop TuneIn for the idle Backdrop app.
2. **HA restarts.** A single, ungrouped Nest Hub playing radio stops whenever Home Assistant restarts (twice in a row on the same day): playing → idle as HA shuts down, off when HA comes back.

**Workaround:** setting the integration's *Allowed UUIDs* to the real devices and saved groups (so HA never connects to temporary groups) stopped case 1. After a restart to apply it, the group played for 5+ minutes; the debug log shows the group discovered and ignore

items.title: Samsung TV volume gone
items.excerpt:
### The problem

Samsung TVs working through this integration now lack volume_level. All tiles using volume now report empty or "on" as the state. HA's own UI has a volume slider but it's pinned at 0 and inspect elements reveals it is %NaN.

It's gone. No Samsung TV has any volume. I am about 98% sure it worked in the previous HA. 2026.10.4? 

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2026.11.0
